'''Rifure Village''' (Japanese: '''リフレ村''' ''Rifure Village'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kanto]]. It is home to [[Kinso]], an artisan who makes [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s including the [[Cerulean Gym]]'s own {{badge|Cascade}}s. It was featured in ''[[HS05|The Blue Badge of Courage]]'', when {{an|Misty}} had to get more Gym Badges; and is located near [[Cerulean City]], at the foot of a mountain and by a lake.
